portInfo.description: Fährhafen Sassnitz GmbH (brand Mukran Port) operates the deep-water ferry/multipurpose harbour at Neu Mukran and publishes a side-by-side cruise facts table against Sassnitz City Harbour. Mukran has been a cruise call for “more than 20 years” per the tourism page and sits ~12 km south of Nationalpark Jasmund. Confirm which harbour your ship uses: Mukran is industrial/deep-water with a longer transfer; City Harbour is walkable into town but with shorter/shallower limits.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Sassnitz mole / harbour stroll — best from City Harbour.
Binz or Kap Arkona — long call.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Mukran does not allow boat tendering; City Harbour does.
